transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, I made this appointment because things have just been really off lately. I guess what scares me most right now is that... well, when I walk across campus—I'm a teaching assistant—it feels like I’m watching everything through glass. It's like I'm not fully in my own body, and the buildings and the students around me just seem slightly unreal. It's a very unsettling feeling, so I figured I needed to come talk to someone.
When that feeling comes on, does it happen during a sudden surge of intense fear or panic?

No, not really. Um, it doesn't feel like a sudden wave of panic or anything like that. I'm not terrified in the moment. It's more just... I'll be walking to a lecture hall and then I just realize I feel completely disconnected. It's more weird and unsettling than a rush of fear.
When this happens, do you still know that the buildings and people only seem unreal, even though part of you feels that way?

Yeah, I mean... I know they're real. Logically, I know I'm just walking across campus and the students are actually there. I don't think I'm hallucinating or anything like that. It's just... the way I'm experiencing it all feels very distant. So, yes, I know it's just a feeling, even though it's a really strange one.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days lately?
No, I wouldn't say that. Um, I haven't really been feeling sad or depressed most days. It's really just that weird, detached feeling I was talking about. But my mood itself hasn't really been down.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to hear or see?
No, nothing like that. I haven't heard any voices or seen anything that isn't actually there. It's really just that sense of things not feeling real, but I know what's actually in front of me.
Have you been worrying a lot about many different things lately?

No, not really. I mean, I have normal stress from work, you know, helping with classes and grading, but... I haven't been worrying about a bunch of different things. It's really just what I've already mentioned to you.
